blinding: The code auditor did not read actual study responses, current first ratings, packets, keys, manifests, condition/model identities, source treatments, API artifacts, WSC/HANS response content, or credentials. All executed fixtures are fabricated.
actions: No API calls or Git writes. Only the analysis helper was patched; collector/capture source, cases, labels, rubric, source scope, sample and response requirements were unchanged.

findings.problem: A coordinator could promote consensus first no/uncertain to primary yes without explicit coordinator mechanism; a final positive could retain no positive mechanism.
findings.synthetic_before: Consensus first no/no with exhaustive empty mechanisms and coordinator_dispositions I001=yes exited successfully.
findings.change: Any final-positive override of the shared first label requires explicit coordinator mechanism adjudication. Every final primary yes requires at least one final mechanism flag yes. Uncertain mechanisms remain uncertain.

findings.problem: --output could overwrite original raw aggregates, receipts, arbitrary pinned sources, artifacts or journals omitted from the original protected set.
findings.synthetic_before: --output responses.jsonl successfully replaced a fabricated raw aggregate.
findings.change: Known immutable/raw/source paths and artifact/journal/methods descendants are protected. Existing files cannot be overwritten except the designated analysis_summary.json; output symlinks and Python source/bytecode destinations are rejected. New custom analysis destinations remain usable.

stderr: ValueError: Explicit separate adjudication required: I001: positive mechanism, I001: no positive final mechanism
ValueError: Refusing to overwrite original input

first_review_proof_limit: The analysis helper verifies current first-file hashes, packet hash and a nonempty frozen_utc declaration before it reads the review key or enriched captures. It does not establish filesystem read-only status, authenticate timestamp chronology, or independently prove who saw the key when. External procedural receipts and Git publication establish that chronology.
retained_limits: This audit gives software evidence only; it does not validate any actual rating, recommendation, source warrant, human adjudication, model comparison or causal claim.

All 72 planned entries, including incomplete/local-failure captures, remain in denominators. Primary, utility and positive-mechanism decisions stay separate; unresolved labels/captures are bounded over [0,1], not silently treated as no.
Case-critical requirement IDs, sources, governing qualifications and substantive rationale remain matters for rubric-based review and coordinator evidence; the helper does not replace that judgment.

Local capture errors remain explicitly unverifiable and incomplete rather than being presented as hash/journal-verified. The advice collector requires a start timestamp for its reported freeze chronology.
The fixed-cell and case/arm results are descriptive. Repetitions are not independent source cases. Same-family agent review remains distinct from human validation.
Replacing an existing custom output requires a new filename; only the designated derived analysis_summary.json may be refreshed.
